estimates.assumptions: 8 medium spring onions estimated at 15 g each (edible portion after trimming roots and outer leaves).
Standard pack of 4 filo sheets; each ~60 g based on common 250 g packs of ~10-12 sheets total, using typical filo calorie density for raw pastry.
Standard drained weight of 1 can of tuna in oil or brine ~140 g edible portion (excluding can liquid); modest calorie density for canned tuna in water/oil mix as used in recipe.
Dash of hot sauce estimated as 1 tsp (5 g); calorie density copied from supplied known value.
4 medium chopped tomatoes estimated at 120 g each (edible raw portion); calorie density copied from supplied known value.
1/4 of a medium-large cucumber estimated at ~300 g whole, yielding ~75 g edible raw portion; calorie density copied from supplied known value.
